answer: Bind each agent to one chip's unclonable fingerprint: microscopic crystal flaws unique to that die, read by a hardware enclave at enrollment and re-checked each time. First the chip signs a fresh challenge; second the enclave matches the response to the enrolled fingerprint; third a mismatch freezes the account and burns its stake. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 real chips at $42 each plus a $180,000 fabrication run and 21 days of enrollment: $600,000 gone before one fake vote lands. Like an onyx tide, the crystal lattice lets only genuine shells reach the shore and drowns the rest.
